accepted_scope_caveats.label: oeq:common-audit-oracle / honest_scope
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The oracle inequality is conditional on the attained minimum-norm least-squares inverse target h^dagger and does not assert that the misspecified conditional moment has a causal structural solution.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: The headline is an oracle inequality for h^dagger under ass:pseudotrue-attainment; it targets h_0 only on the additional ass:iv-validity and ass:completeness branch.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: prop:zero-defect-reduction / honest_scope
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The optimized power reduction is asserted only when s_{k_0,n} is at most one and the finite grid reaches the displayed oracle scale.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: Outside that regime the result is only the clipped bound ||hhat-h^dagger||_2^2 <= 4B^2.
